Container.Name: ollama
Container.Overview: Ollama — local LLM runtime for the Ollama Cursor Agent stack on Unraid.[br][br]After install, open the container console and run: [b]ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b[/b][br][br]Set [b]Ollama Host[/b] to [b]0.0.0.0:11434[/b] so other containers (and the agent template) can reach the API. For NVIDIA GPUs, add [b]--gpus all[/b] under Extra Parameters (requires NVIDIA Driver + Container Toolkit on Unraid).
Container.Changes: Initial Unraid template for Ollama Cursor Agent stack.

Config.Name: Ollama Host
Config.Description: Listen address. Use 0.0.0.0:11434 so the agent container can connect via your server IP.

Config.Name: Origins (CORS)
Config.Description: Allowed browser origins (* for local LAN tools)
